gcp_bucket_logging_enabled_fb7cc594582a.summary: Configure an approved Cloud Storage usage-log destination for this bucket.
steps: Inspect logging.logBucket on the exact full-projection bucket and confirm that usage/storage logs are required for this selected bucket.
Choose a dedicated log bucket and prefix with the data owner, including write access for Cloud Storage analytics and a retention plan, then apply the reviewed logging configuration.
Read back logging.logBucket, check that usage logs arrive in the approved destination, recollect and rerun this check.
caveats: Cloud Storage usage and storage logs create billable objects and delivery is not guaranteed to be timely or complete; review cost and retention before enabling them.
Google generally recommends Cloud Audit Logs to track API operations, but this signed predicate tests the distinct bucket logging.logBucket field and does not infer that Audit Logs satisfy it.

references.title: Cloud Storage usage logs, pricing and delivery caveats
